compiled_kernel_resources.scope: Static compiler declarations, not measured occupancy.

implementation: Four exact IU8 matrix products form signed high and lower32-bit components whose full value is high*65536+lower. Window4/8 publishes them in separate LDS planes and reuses the existing116-byte immutable integer-core rows. Each output has one actual ordered carry. When that carry exponent dominates both row maxima, is within-101..127 and yields alignment shift3..16, the high term is exactly divisible by the alignment scale. Signed per-product remainders are removed from the bounded lower term before division. Original BF16 encoding exceptions are corrected with the original product primitive. The original carry is already aligned; all terms are added modulo2^32 and use the established bounded sign decoder plus canonical normalization. Rejection retains the existing full64-bit core and original BF16 fallback. No approximate predictor, stored plan, changed output rounding or product dispatcher is introduced.
correctness_scope: Host sanitizers check1572864 generated input/carry combinations against independent wide original group arithmetic, including positive and negative maximum modulo overlap. Rejected state and diagnostic outputs remain unchanged. Native60 reports compare every score and masked slot to original canonical GPU scores, with3840 independent CPU dots. Every generated and captured integer encoding is checked against complete CPU preparation. Captured warmup and all three measured attempts verify all scores, guards and unused tails. Separate audited launches outside timers verify output parity and count fast/original groups and compensated pairs, which agree across both window sizes. Captured q8192 repeats the first1023 rows of the original q7169 Q/K; it is not a real model prompt or token loop. References are comparison inputs only.
timing_scope: One warmup plus three completed samples per query slab with variant order rotated across slabs. Candidate clocks include each slab query encoding and all matrix/ordered-compensation work; one complete key encoding is added once. The selected prepared-QK arm includes its own complete Q/K encoding and key transpose once. Allocation, buffer resets, validation and explicit audit launches are outside clocks. No load time, TTFT, decode or retained product performance is inferred.

decision.decision: Keep isolated. Both exact matrix windows regress on both captured shapes despite more than82% of ordered groups entering the exact32-bit branch. Window4 adds625.0626ms at q8192 versus the selected prepared scalar path; window8 is slower still. Reduced static VGPR declarations do not establish occupancy or a runtime benefit. Retain current product dispatch and pursue a broader reduction of exact replay cost; this result does not prohibit a materially different matrix design.
